title: Kissed Smoke Hot Hakka Fish Scallion Pancake
description: A fatty and snappy Hakka dish featuring piccalilli and smoke-hot flavors, wrapped in a pandan leaf, making it a kid-friendly and pescatarian-friendly option.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour and eggs to make a smooth batter.
Add chopped scallions and smoked paprika to the batter and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan with some vegetable oil and pour in the batter to make a thin pancake.
Cook the pancake until it is golden brown and crispy, then flip it over and cook the other side.
In a separate pan, heat some vegetable oil and fry the fish balls until they are golden brown.
Add piccalilli to the pan and stir fry for a minute.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked pancake on a pandan leaf, add some fried fish balls and piccalilli, and fold the leaf to wrap.
Serve the Kissed Smoke Hot Hakka Fish Scallion Pancake hot and enjoy.
Repeat the process to make 12 pancakes.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions and smoked paprika if desired.
